purpose: Give Mythical Void a truthful adult-facing sharing pack that connects a real game screen, a credited NASA public image and an optional observation activity without blurring science and fiction.

selection.reason: The Apollo 11 discovery screen is already present in the running game, shows its source and credit, asks an evidence-based question and keeps the fictional creature reaction in a separate labelled area.

audience.primary: Adults, parents and guardians, educators, adult creators, press, industry and partners

assets.alt: Wide Mythical Void space-discovery artwork with a real game screen, credited Apollo 11 image and the words Real space, strange worlds, questions worth asking
assets.disclosure: Branded sharing layout, not a raw screenshot. The framed screen is real gameplay using a company-controlled test state and contains a credited NASA public image; no player information is shown. NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

assets.alt: Square Mythical Void space-discovery artwork with a real game screen, credited Apollo 11 image and an observation question

professionalNetwork.copy:
A real-space sharing kit is ready

Adults, families, educators and creators can now share wide or square Mythical Void artwork built around a real game screen and a credited NASA Apollo 11 image.

• Both layouts use the clean mythicalvoid.com/nasa-space-science address with no tracking code.
• The framed screen comes from the running game and clearly credits the NASA public image inside it.
• The complete layouts are branded sharing artwork, not raw screenshots, and NASA does not endorse Mythical Void.

See what changed: https://mythicalvoid.com/press/#nasa-stem-social-assets
